_about: The recipe scripts/ai-catalog.js turns into data/ai/catalog.ron (docs/design/embeddable-ai.md, 6.2; rung 2, 2026-11-09). Edit THIS file, never the catalog: the script measures each file (its size and SHA-256), refuses one that does not match its publisher's hash, splits anything over part_bytes into parts, and writes the catalog the app compiles in. Only what can be downloaded today is listed: Gemma 4 and Pocket TTS are absent until their rungs bring their files (data/ai/choices.ron still shows what each will need).
_part_bytes: GitHub's limit is 'Each file included in a release must be under 2 GiB' (the runtime finding, F10). A file larger than this many bytes goes up as parts of at most this size, each with its own hash, joined and checked whole after download. 2,000,000,000 is 7% under the limit (2026-11-11), so no published file sits a hair below it: Ministral 3 3B (2,147,023,008 bytes) is only 460,640 bytes under 2 GiB and goes up as two parts. src/ai/catalog.rs PART_LIMIT is the app's copy; scripts/check-ai-catalog.js holds the two equal.

engine._credits: Rows in data/credits.ron (scripts/check-ai-catalog.js refuses a catalog entry without one): llama.cpp and ggml, whose code is inside the engine; and the llama-cpp-rs project, whose crate llama-cpp-sys-2 carries the pinned llama.cpp source the engine builds (none of its own code is compiled in).

extras._why: Apache 2.0 section 4(a): 'You must give any other recipients of the Work or Derivative Works a copy of this License'. The text is apache.org's (SHA-256 cfc7749b...), which the Granite finding (F1) compared with IBM's LICENSE line by line: the same, IBM's having one leading blank line.

extras.text: Granite 4.0 1B (Q4_K_M GGUF) by IBM, https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.0-1b-GGUF, Apache License 2.0. Unmodified. Training data disclosure: https://github.com/ibm-granite/granite-4.0-nano-language-models/tree/main/disclosures.
extras._why: The credit README exactly as the Granite finding wrote it ('How the project would credit it').

models._what: The stronger brain for talking characters (the Rich choice, embeddable-ai.md 4.2), beside Granite's quick one. Mistral's own text-only GGUF, unmodified (its hash is Mistral's); the mmproj vision file is not published. The finding's conditions (its 2026-11-11 addendum): the Apache 2.0 text and the credit beside it, the project's own system prompt and NEVER the repository's SYSTEM_PROMPT.txt (it says it is Mistral's Le Chat), an AI label wherever it speaks (rung 3), the text model only.

extras._why: Apache 2.0 section 4(a): 'You must give any other recipients of the Work or Derivative Works a copy of this License'. Mistral's repository has no LICENSE file (the Ministral finding, F5), so the text is apache.org's, the same file Granite carries.
